summary: Republic Power Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K, a report of a foreign private issuer under the SEC's 1934 Act, covering its semi-annual period ended December 31, 2025. It does not announce any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change.
